verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that the Vanta API automates evidence collection for security awareness training systems (vanta-docs-32). Separately, auditors can review personnel in scope for an engagement (vanta-docs-29). Together these suggest training data can feed audit evidence, but through external training systems rather than training built into Vanta. Missing for 10: evidence of built-in training content, automatic assignment on hire, completion tracking and reminders, and any confirmation that auditors accept training records as evidence, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
